whenToUse: The screen after too many failed passwords, with a countdown and recent failed attempts.
An unlock flow via emailed code that ends with setting a new password.
avoidWhen: Routine password recovery without a lockout — use forgot-password-01.
Account blocked by permissions rather than attempts — use no-access-01.
a11y: The countdown uses role="timer" and status changes are announced via aria-live.
Explain the wait in text, not only with the draining bar.
